Cut datapoints to x limits from config

cut_to_x_range.Rd

takes the maximum range of all the series in the datapoints tables and then cuts it down by the values of xmin and xmax passed in the config dictionary. If the intervals don't overlap, uses just the datapoint range, ignoring the user input.

Usage

cut_to_x_range(datapoints, config)

Arguments

datapoints

list of dataframes from prep_data

config

config dictionary list from prep_config

Value

a list with the xmin and xmax values of the data in date format and the filtered datapoints

Details

config$xmax is always the first day of its period (parse_spec_date's contract), but center_dates() has already shifted plotted dates to mid-period before this runs. A literal comparison against config$xmax would therefore always exclude the period xmax names. xmax is rounded up to the last day of its period before being used as a bound; xmin is left as-is since mid-period dates are always >= first-of-period.

Returns filtered datapoints.
